'''Marith Jaen''' was [[Amyrlin Seat]] from {{ne|984}} to {{Ne|988}}. She was raised from the [[Blue Ajah]].{{ref/book|bwb|24}}

== History and Influence ==
Born in {{ne|700}}, she went to the White Tower in {{ne|717}}. She is described in the [[Companion]] as being a "stainless-steel bitch".

She retired to the country in {{ne|973}} when [[Tamra Ospenya]] was raised [[Amyrlin Seat]]. It was speculated that she did so because of personality clashes with Tamra, and because she wanted to be Amyrlin instead. Her stated reason was that she wished to write her memoirs.

After the death of [[Sierin Vayu]] in {{ne|984}}, Marith was called from retirement to take the Amyrlin Seat. The Hall felt they had no choice, as both Tamra and Sierin had died suddenly, as had many senior sisters (as part of the [[Black Ajah|Black Ajah's]] efforts to find the [[Dragon Reborn]] for themselves).

In {{ne|985}}, she sentenced the [[Red]] [[Sitters]] [[Toveine Gazal]], [[Lirene Doirellin]], and [[Tsutama Rath]] to exile and hard labor on a farm for their role in [[gentling]] male [[channelers]] outside of the [[White Tower]]. They were publicly unseated and birched in front of the White Tower, without any explanation for the outside world. This only cemented her fearsome reputation. During her tenure as Amyrlin, the [[Hall of the Tower]] was fully under her control and the influence of the Tower increased in the outside world.

Marith was the last of three Amyrlins to have died in a short stretch of time. Her death in {{ne|988}}, although sudden, was of natural causes. She was replaced by [[Siuan Sanche]]. The exceptionally young Siuan was chosen in light of the numerous recent deaths of many senior Sisters and Amyrlins in a very short space of time, and the Hall opted for someone who could provide stability by potentially reigning for centuries.{{ref/book|7|7}}

Marith held the position for 4 years from {{ne|984}} to {{ne|988}}. She was [[Sierin Vayu]]'s successor and [[Siuan Sanche]]'s predecessor.

== Other ==

It is not known who was [[Keeper of the Chronicles]] during her tenure as Amyrlin, but the [[Companion]] states that every Keeper not of the same Ajah as the Amyrlin was forced by the Hall. Given Marith's domination of the Hall, this seems unlikely and therefore her Keeper would probably have been from the Blue Ajah.
